1933, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 145
Sep. 19 Peter Flanagan - 53 - ??? groth on lung seemingly. Drs. baffled fear ... . Oct. 4 Reports Cured ..... Flu in Febr. O.K. now. See 10-4
Dan. Chas. Cameron - 25 - helpless with arthritis for 3 yrs. Re- latives making Gen. novena to St. Theresa for help ...
John Dwyer - 69 - cancer ... Mrs. Law - Nervous - O.K. Drs. Surprised
Sep. 20 Dan Ross - 17 - enrolled last March as against ulcers of stomach Reported To-day as never having vomited since. Now robust and healthy. Deo Gr!
Vivian Downs of Pittsburg - 36 - serious operation' - speedy re- covery.
22 Marcella Cassin - 13 - 19367 San Juan, Eye infection & cateract in left eye. M., youngest of three never baptized - mother pres- biterian - father ten yrs. away from Easter.
Joseph Hinsberg - 3 - quite hopeless asthma - enrolled this P.M. - Mother promising perpet'1.
Arthur Haddock - 31 - Enrolled in Sept. or Oct. 1930 at time had sleeping sickness and double vision. Improvement followed - espe- cially when they prayed to Archangel Raphael ... Now perfectly O.K.
23 Mrs. Gus Werth - 43 - hit in eye by burglar :- 4 weeks ago, has threatened loss of eye.
John Patrick Scanlan - 52 - terrible asthma - enrolled to-night for yr.
Mrs. Mary Graham - 28 at St. Joseph Retreat. ....
24 Most hopeless cancer cured. During February Mrs. & Dr. Jaques begged priest to come over to Windsor, to see their sister, Flo- rence, to have stomach cancer removed. Operation early in March only hope - in prayer .... promised perpetual enrollment if spared ... Enrolled March 16 accordingly. Comes To-day apparently in good health.
Page 146 Sep. 24 Miss Louise Pellerin - 79 - Reconciliation - Family going to pieces. Mary Schlon - 28 - Terrible rhumatism
